description: This file defines a class 'Basic' which extends the core Controller class in the Opencart admin extension, specifically related to a CAPTCHA extension. It contains methods to display the CAPTCHA configuration page and save its settings.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: Controller class for handling the basic CAPTCHA configuration in the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the CAPTCHA configuration page with breadcrumbs, header, footer, and current settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the CAPTCHA settings, including permission checks and returning success or error messages in JSON format.
